summary: Greenfield bootstrap handles empty repos, avoids argv overflow on large payload uploads, omits test media from the template payload, and ships a generic `.agentic/COSTS.md` starter (#1152).
migration_impact: Downstream adopters on plate-core with this fix can run `gh plate bootstrap --greenfield --apply` on an empty GitHub repository without a manual README commit. Re-running apply after a partial failure is safe: identical files are skipped and remaining bootstrap steps still run. Bootstrap adds `.agentic/COSTS.md` only when missing; existing cost logs are preserved.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / gh-plate to a build that includes this fix.
2. On empty repositories, run `gh plate bootstrap --repo OWNER/REPO --greenfield --apply` without seeding an initial commit manually.
3. If a prior apply stopped mid-way, rerun the same command; it will skip files that already match the template and complete labels, `.plate`, starter questions, and release branches.
agent_notes: GitHub contents PUT bodies use `gh api --input` JSON (never argv). Template payload excludes tests/spike-videos and large e2e GIF fixtures. Bootstrap seeds README.md when the default branch ref is missing. Payload includes a generic `.agentic/COSTS.md` header (no harvested rows); manifest `preserve_existing` skips overwrite when a cost log already exists.
